title: Ratios, rates and proportions
hook: Set up equal fractions with matching units in matching places.

steps.prompt: From memory: boys to girls is 3 : 5 in a class of 32. How many girls?
steps.answer: 20. There are $3 + 5 = 8$ parts, $32 \div 8 = 4$ students per part, and $5 \times 4 = 20$.
